subject: CWE-345
object: The product does not sufficiently verify the origin or authenticity of data, in a way that causes it to accept invalid data.

subject: CWE-20
object:
The product receives input or data, but it does
        not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the
        properties that are required to process the data safely and
        correctly.
